capabilities: Insert the configured number of spaces per indent
Apply the Indent visual width setting to space indentation
Open a demo vault that demonstrates the feature
disambiguation: It does nothing when you indent with tabs; it only changes how many spaces each indent inserts.
extras: Documentation is a demo vault shipped with each release and browsable on GitHub; beta versions install via BRAT; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Obsidian has an Indent visual width setting, and then ignores it whenever you indent with spaces
problem: Obsidian honors the indent width setting for tabs but always inserts exactly four spaces when Indent using tabs is off.

relations.evidence: Same indentation goal; uses core Indent visual width; no extra setting/key handler
Alternative indentation: keeps spaces; changes their count per indent
Ensure you have the BRAT plugin installed and enabled.

summary: Editor fix that makes Tab insert the number of spaces set in Obsidian's Indent visual width setting instead of a hardcoded four.
